name: deploymedic
description: Evidence-first deployment diagnostics — CLI, report viewer, and docs.
author: NullEx17

scripts.build: npm run build -w @deploymedic/core && npm run build -w @deploymedic/cli && npm run build -w @deploymedic/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @deploymedic/web && npm run lint -w @deploymedic/cli && npm run lint -w @deploymedic/core
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @deploymedic/core && npm run typecheck -w @deploymedic/cli && npm run typecheck -w @deploymedic/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @deploymedic/core && npm run test -w @deploymedic/cli
